content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ITI Rajpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://balrampur.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ITI Rajpur Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ITI Rajpur Guest Lecturer posts is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Lecturer position at Industrial Training Institute Rajpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for the posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for all the advertised posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 50/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Merit List.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Guest Lecturer positions is Rs. 140 - 15000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications for the Stenographer & Secretarial Assistant (Hindi) post?
faq.answer: For the Stenographer & Secretarial Assistant (Hindi) post, candidates need High School, NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade, Hindi Shorthand proficiency, and a Data Entry Operator diploma. CTI/ATI passed candidates are preferred.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for ITI Rajpur?
faq.answer: The official website for ITI Rajpur is https://balrampur.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The completed application form should be sent to the address mentioned in the official notification through Speed Post/Registered Post.
